panels.title: 💻 Host, Conversazioni e Log dei Flussi (Tabella: Tema2)

targets.rawSql: SELECT src_ip, src_app_name, count(*) as packets_sent, sum(length) as bytes_sent FROM Tema2 WHERE 1=1 AND src_app_name != 'Local Network' GROUP BY src_ip, src_app_name ORDER BY bytes_sent DESC LIMIT 10;
targets.query: SELECT src_ip, src_app_name, count(*) as packets_sent, sum(length) as bytes_sent FROM Tema2 WHERE 1=1 AND src_app_name != 'Local Network' GROUP BY src_ip, src_app_name ORDER BY bytes_sent DESC LIMIT 10;

targets.rawSql: SELECT dst_ip, dst_app_name, geo_country, count(*) as packets_received, sum(length) as bytes_received FROM Tema2 WHERE 1=1 AND dst_app_name != 'Local Network' GROUP BY dst_ip, dst_app_name, geo_country ORDER BY bytes_received DESC LIMIT 10;

targets.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT timestamp, src_app_name, dst_app_name, geo_country, length FROM Tema2 WHERE 1=1 AND geo_country NOT IN ('Local', 'Local Network') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100) ORDER BY timestamp ASC;

targets.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT src_ip, count(DISTINCT dst_port) as unique_ports_targeted, count(*) as total_packets FROM Tema2 WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY src_ip ORDER BY unique_ports_targeted DESC) WHERE unique_ports_targeted > 5;

targets.query: SELECT CASE tls_version WHEN '0x0304' THEN 'TLS 1.3' WHEN '0x0303' THEN 'TLS 1.2' WHEN '0x0302' THEN 'TLS 1.1' WHEN '0x0301' THEN 'TLS 1.0' WHEN '0x0300' THEN 'SSL 3.0' WHEN '0x0002' THEN 'SSL 2.0' ELSE tls_version END as tls_version, count(*) as count FROM Tema2 WHERE 1=1 AND length(tls_version) > 0 GROUP BY tls_version;
